verdict.rationale: A compute platform could plausibly offer built-in AI insights, for example over its logs, metrics or spend, so this story applies to Modal. The evidence shows only general-purpose infrastructure: GPUs, inference endpoints, logs and metrics, and an agent skill for coding agents. Those are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not product-generated AI insights or suggestions from the user's data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
